properties.summary: Incident Type: FIXED - NRC Report ID: 952506 - Medium Affected: LAND - Suspected Responsible Party: WHEELABRATOR SAUGUS, INC.
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 952506
Incident Time: 2010-08-24 17:45:00
Nearest City: Salem, MA
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: BOILER WASH WATER
Medium Affected: LAND
Suspected Responsible Party: WHEELABRATOR SAUGUS, INC.
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 15 gallons
FACILITY IS A MUNICIPAL WASTE COMBUSTOR THAT BURNS MUNICIPAL SOLID WASTE AND PRODUCES ELECTRICITY. BOILER #1 WAS OFFLINE ON AUGUST 24TH FOR ANNUAL COLD IRON OUTAGE. BOILER INTERNALS WERE WASHED AT THIS TIME WITH WATER. THE WASH WATER ROUTED TO A CONVEYOR INSIDE THE BUILDING. THIS CONVEYOR OVERFLOWED, AND APPROX. 15 GALLONS OF WASH WATER ESCAPED THROUGH A JOINT IN THE BUILDING SIDING TO OUTSIDE PAVEMENT. THE SPILL WAS IMMEDIATELY CLEANED UP WITH SPEEDI-DRI. A SAMPLE OF THE WATER WAS COLLECTED AND SENT TO LAB FOR TCLP TEST. SAMPLE RESULTS RECEIVED ON AUGUST 30 REVEALED WATER FAILED TCLP FOR LEAD (D008) AND CADMIUM (D006) AND SELENIUM (D011). WASTES THAT FAIL FOR THESE METALS HAVE 10 POUND RQ.

Report DescriptionDESCRIPTION OF SPILL SITE AND SURROUNDING AREA: THIS REPORT NOTIFIES B.C. PARTNERS THAT ON 01/10/24, STAFF WORKING IN WASHINGTON STATE AS PART OF THE WHATCOM CLEAN WATER PROGRAM (WCWP) COLLECTED SAMPLES FROM STREAMS FLOWING FROM BRITISH COLUMBIA INTO WHATCOM COUNTY. THESE SAMPLES WERE ANALYZED AT AN ACCREDITED LAB ON 01/11/24 AND FOUND TO EXCEED WATER QUALITY HEALTH BENCHMARKS FOR FECAL COLIFORM. THESE ELEVATED RESULTS WERE DOCUMENTED IN THE BERTRAND CREEK DRAINAGE. SAMPLES WERE COLLECTED AFTER A LARGE MIXED PRECIPITATION EVENT, WHICH DEPOSITED OVER 1.0 INCH OF RAIN THE DAY OF AND TWO DAYS PRIOR TO SAMPLE COLLECTION IN THE REGION SAMPLED. FIELD NOTES INDICATE THAT STREAM FLOWS WERE ABOVE NORMAL LEVELS (MODERATELY HIGH TO HIGH FLOW) AND THE WATER AT MOST SITES WAS SLIGHTLY CLOUDY WITH FOAM. DOWNSTREAM SITES FOR BERTRAND CREEKS (BHPB, BE4.3, BE1.8, AND B1) WERE ALSO HIGHLY ELEVATED PRIOR TO ENTRY INTO THE NOOKSACK RIVER. WE DID NOT COLLECT NOOKSACK RIVER DATA ON THIS DATE AND CANNOT, THEREFORE, ASSESS WHETHER BERTRAND CREEK INFLUENCED BACTERIA LEVELS IN THE NOOKSACK RIVER MAINSTEM. FOLLOW UP SAMPLING IN THE U.S. PORTION OF BERTRAND CREEK WATERSHED WILL TAKE PLACE AS TIME AND STAFF ALLOW.
